hpi: The patient is a 68-year-old female with a history of hyperlipidemia and diabetes who presented with muscle weakness. She was started on Simvastatin and Gemfibrozil for her hyperlipidemia. After a few weeks, she developed muscle weakness and was found to have elevated creatine kinase levels. The case highlights the importance of monitoring for myopathy in patients on statins, especially when combined with other medications that can increase the risk of muscle injury.

patient_voice.chief_complaint: I'm really scared. My muscles feel weak and I can't do things I used to.
patient_voice.history: I started feeling weak after taking my new medication. I didn't think it would affect me like this.
patient_voice.pain: It feels like my legs are heavy and I can't lift them.
